text: The purpose of this report is to recommend that Toronto and East York Community Council appoint directors to the College Promenade, Downtown Yonge, Midtown Yonge, Ossington Avenue, Rosedale Main Street and St. Lawrence Market Neighbourhood BIA Boards of Management and remove directors from the College Promenade, Downtown Yonge, Midtown Yonge, Mount Pleasant and St. Lawrence Market Neighbourhood BIA Boards of Management.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. In accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, appointed the following nominees to the Business Improvement Area Boards of Management set out below at the pleasure of Toronto and East York Community Council, and for a term expiring at the end of the term of Council or as soon thereafter as successors are appointed: Bloor Annex: Sdao, Larry College Promenade: Tang, Tom Downtown Yonge: Cockburn, Braeden Grass, Jennifer Midtown Yonge: Lake, David Ossington Avenue: Keenlyside, Sarah Rosedale Main Street: Davis, Laura St. Lawrence Market Neighbourhood: Chalmers, Tiffany Tootikian, Armen 2. Removed the following directors from the Business Improvement Area Boards of Management set out below: Bloor Annex: Arbeid, Esther College Promenade: Clementino, Bernadette Genttner, Michelle Downtown Yonge: McGinn, Erin Seaman, Paul Midtown Yonge:…
